# Silex — Stop Gambling

> An iPhone and Android app that blocks gambling across the phone, runs a 90-day quit program built from CBT workbooks and gambling research, and tracks the money you keep. No accounts, no ads, and nothing a user writes leaves the phone. Built by Kyrylo Lozovyi. Weekly $2.99 or annual $29.99 with a 7-day free trial (US prices; lower in many countries).

Each link below is the Markdown version of a page; drop `index.md` for the web page.

The full text of every page, in one file: https://trysilex.com/llms-full.txt

Product documentation (setup, blocking, subscriptions, privacy): https://trysilex.com/docs/llms.txt

## Pages

- [Quit gambling. Keep the money.](https://trysilex.com/index.md): Silex blocks gambling across your iPhone or Android phone, walks you through a 90-day quit program built from CBT workbooks, and counts the money you keep. No accounts, no ads, no profile of you.
- [Who builds Silex](https://trysilex.com/about/index.md): Silex is built by one developer, Kyrylo Lozovyi, in Kyiv. No investors, no growth team, nothing that profiles you — and a short list of rules the app will not break.
- [The best gambling blocker apps, compared honestly](https://trysilex.com/best-gambling-blocker-apps/index.md): Gamban, BetBlocker, GamBlock and the rest — what each one covers, what it costs, and which to pick. Prices verified from each vendor's own site, with a disclosure: we make one of these.
- [How to block gambling on Android](https://trysilex.com/block-gambling-apps-android/index.md): Android's built-in Private DNS blocks gambling in every app and browser for free, in about two minutes. Plus a PIN someone else keeps, and which third-party blockers are worth it.
- [How to block gambling sites and apps on iPhone](https://trysilex.com/block-gambling-sites-iphone/index.md): Every working method for blocking gambling on an iPhone — Screen Time, a system-wide DNS profile, Safari content blockers, bank blocks and self-exclusion — with what each one actually covers and how easily you can undo it.
- [How to make your bank decline gambling payments](https://trysilex.com/block-gambling-transactions-bank/index.md): Bank gambling blocks decline payments to betting operators and take days to lift. Which UK banks offer one, what US cardholders can do instead, and why the cooling-off period is the whole point.
- [Silex documentation](https://trysilex.com/docs/index.md): How to set up and use Silex, the iPhone app that blocks gambling and runs a 90-day quit program: protection, the SOS button, the program, subscriptions and privacy.
- [Getting started](https://trysilex.com/docs/getting-started/index.md): What Silex asks during onboarding, why it asks it, the risk score and plan it builds, and Day 1, which opens right after you subscribe.
- [Notifications and widgets](https://trysilex.com/docs/notifications/index.md): Every notification Silex sends and when, the discreet wording for shared phones, and the Home Screen, Lock Screen and Control Center widgets.
- [Privacy and your data](https://trysilex.com/docs/privacy-and-data/index.md): What Silex stores, where (your phone and your private iCloud), the three services it uses, how to turn analytics off, and how to delete everything.
- [The 90-day program](https://trysilex.com/docs/program/index.md): How the Silex 90-day program is structured: three phases, one short lesson a day, how days unlock, milestone days, and what happens after a lapse.
- [Progress, money kept and orbs](https://trysilex.com/docs/progress/index.md): How Silex counts gamble-free days and the money you've kept, what a slip takes off, plus the daily pledge, the journal and all 20 orbs.
- [Protection layers](https://trysilex.com/docs/protection/index.md): How Silex blocks gambling: the system-wide DNS shield, the Safari content blocker, and the self-exclusion, bank-block and promo layers you set up outside the app.
- [Settings reference](https://trysilex.com/docs/settings/index.md): Every option in Silex Settings: money display, goal and currency, notifications, support links, restoring and managing your subscription, and analytics.
- [The SOS button](https://trysilex.com/docs/sos/index.md): How the Silex SOS flow works step by step, and how to open it from Control Center, Siri and Shortcuts.
- [Subscriptions](https://trysilex.com/docs/subscriptions/index.md): Silex plans and prices, how the free trial and its reminder work, how to cancel, restore a purchase or get a refund, and what keeps working if your subscription ends.
- [Troubleshooting](https://trysilex.com/docs/troubleshooting/index.md): Fixes for the common Silex problems: the DNS shield stuck on Installed, the Safari blocker missing, the paywall after paying, and notifications not arriving.
- [Gamban alternatives](https://trysilex.com/gamban-alternatives/index.md): Gamban costs £4.99 a month or £29.99 a year. Here are the free and paid alternatives that cover the same job, what each does better, and when Gamban is still the right answer.
- [Gambling debt: where to start](https://trysilex.com/gambling-debt-help/index.md): How to deal with debt from gambling — stop the bleeding, work out what's actually owed, get free charity debt advice, and avoid the consolidation traps aimed at people in exactly this position.
- [Gambling loss calculator](https://trysilex.com/gambling-loss-calculator/index.md): Put in what you lose in a typical week and see the yearly, 5-year and 10-year total, plus what the same money would have compounded to. Runs in your browser; nothing is stored.
- [What happens when you stop gambling](https://trysilex.com/gambling-recovery-timeline/index.md): Withdrawal, sleep, mood, money and the danger points — what the first 90 days after quitting gambling commonly look like, and which weeks people actually relapse in.
- [I gambled again — what to do now](https://trysilex.com/gambling-relapse/index.md): A slip is not the end of quitting — how you interpret it decides what happens next. The abstinence violation effect, the practical first hour after a lapse, and how to turn it into information.
- [The 9-question gambling self-check (PGSI)](https://trysilex.com/gambling-self-check/index.md): Take the Problem Gambling Severity Index (PGSI) — the same 9-question screener clinicians and helplines use. Runs entirely in your browser, stores nothing, sends nothing.
- [Someone you love is gambling](https://trysilex.com/help-someone-with-gambling-addiction/index.md): Practical steps for partners and families: protect the household money first, why paying the debt backfires, how to have the conversation, and where to get support for yourself.
- [How long do gambling urges last?](https://trysilex.com/how-long-do-gambling-urges-last/index.md): A gambling urge behaves like a wave: it rises, crests and falls, usually inside 20 to 30 minutes, whether or not you bet. What the first weeks feel like, and the urge-surfing technique that uses the pattern.
- [How to stop gambling](https://trysilex.com/how-to-stop-gambling/index.md): A practical, evidence-based plan for quitting gambling: the three barriers to put up first, how to ride out an urge, what the first 90 days look like, and where to get free human help.
- [How to stop sports betting](https://trysilex.com/how-to-stop-sports-betting/index.md): Sports betting is harder to quit than casino gambling because the trigger is the sport itself. What to block, what to do about watching games, and how to handle the group chat.
- [How the program was built, and from what](https://trysilex.com/methodology/index.md): The clinical and academic sources behind Silex's 90-day quit-gambling program: CBT for gambling disorder, the PGSI self-check, relapse-prevention research, and the literature on how gambling products are engineered.
- [A gambling recovery tracker for Notion](https://trysilex.com/notion-recovery-tracker/index.md): One click sets up a quit-gambling tracker in your own Notion: an urge log, a money-kept table and your reasons for stopping. Free, and Silex keeps no copy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://trysilex.com/privacy/index.md): Silex stores nothing about you on any server, holds no accounts, and cannot read anything you write in the app. The full GDPR and UK GDPR notice, including the few places data does leave your phone.
- [Self-exclusion: the strongest block there is](https://trysilex.com/self-exclusion-guide/index.md): How gambling self-exclusion works in the UK via GAMSTOP and in the US state by state, what it covers, what it misses, and why it is the strongest layer available — free, and irreversible on purpose.
- [Support](https://trysilex.com/support/index.md): Help with Silex: subscriptions and cancelling, restoring a purchase, the DNS shield, the Safari blocker, and how to reach a human.
- [Terms of Use](https://trysilex.com/terms/index.md): The terms for the Silex app, this website's free tools, the browser extension and the Notion recovery tracker. Short, plain, and honest about what Silex is not.

- [Skyddslager](https://trysilex.com/sv/docs/protection/index.md) (Svenska): Så blockerar Silex spel om pengar: DNS-skölden för hela systemet, Safari-blockeraren och lagren utanför appen: Spelpaus, banken och reklamen.
- [Inställningarna i detalj](https://trysilex.com/sv/docs/settings/index.md) (Svenska): Varje val i Inställningar i Silex: behållna pengar, mål och valuta, notiser, stöd, återställa och hantera din prenumeration, och analys.
- [SOS-knappen](https://trysilex.com/sv/docs/sos/index.md) (Svenska): Så fungerar SOS-flödet i Silex steg för steg, och så öppnar du det från Kontrollcenter, Siri och Genvägar.
- [Prenumerationer](https://trysilex.com/sv/docs/subscriptions/index.md) (Svenska): Alternativ och priser, hur provperioden och påminnelsen fungerar, hur du säger upp, återställer ett köp eller får pengarna tillbaka, och vad som finns kvar.
- [Felsökning](https://trysilex.com/sv/docs/troubleshooting/index.md) (Svenska): Lösningar på vanliga problem: DNS-skölden som fastnar på Installerad, Safari-blockeraren som saknas, betalväggen efter köp och notiser som inte kommer.
- [Spelskulder: börja här](https://trysilex.com/sv/hjalp-med-spelskulder/index.md) (Svenska): Så tar du tag i spelskulder: stoppa förlusterna, skriv ner vad du är skyldig, få gratis budget- och skuldrådgivning i din kommun och undvik fällorna.
- [Någon du älskar spelar om pengar](https://trysilex.com/sv/hjalpa-nagon-med-spelberoende/index.md) (Svenska): Konkreta steg för dig som är anhörig till någon med spelberoende: skydda hushållets pengar, varför det slår fel att betala skulden, och var du själv får stöd.
- [Hur länge varar ett spelsug?](https://trysilex.com/sv/hur-lange-varar-spelsug/index.md) (Svenska): Ett spelsug är som en våg: det stiger, når toppen och faller, oftast inom 20 till 30 minuter, vare sig du spelar eller inte. Så surfar du på suget.
- [Integritetspolicy](https://trysilex.com/sv/integritet/index.md) (Svenska): Silex lagrar inget om dig på någon server, har inga konton och kan inte läsa det du skriver. Hela GDPR-texten, och de få fall då data lämnar telefonen.
- [Så byggdes programmet, och av vad](https://trysilex.com/sv/metod/index.md) (Svenska): Källorna bakom Silex 90-dagarsprogram för att sluta spela om pengar: KBT vid spelberoende, självtestet PGSI, återfallsprevention och hur spel konstrueras.
- [En loggbok i Notion för att sluta spela om pengar](https://trysilex.com/sv/notion-recovery-tracker/index.md) (Svenska): Ett klick skapar en loggbok i din egen Notion: sug, behållna pengar och dina skäl att sluta spela om pengar. Gratis, och Silex sparar ingen kopia.
- [Vem som bygger Silex](https://trysilex.com/sv/om-silex/index.md) (Svenska): Silex byggs av en enda utvecklare, Kyrylo Lozovyi i Kyiv. Inga investerare, ingen tillväxtavdelning, inget som profilerar dig, och några regler som inte bryts.
- [Räkna ut dina spelförluster](https://trysilex.com/sv/rakna-ut-spelforluster/index.md) (Svenska): Skriv in vad du förlorar en vanlig vecka och se summan på ett, fem och tio år, och vad samma pengar hade kunnat växa till. Inget sparas.
- [Så slutar du med sportspel](https://trysilex.com/sv/sluta-med-sportspel/index.md) (Svenska): Sportspel är svårare att sluta med än casino, för triggern är sporten själv. Vad du spärrar, hur du gör med matcherna och vad du säger i gruppchatten.
- [Så slutar du spela om pengar](https://trysilex.com/sv/sluta-spela/index.md) (Svenska): En konkret plan för att sluta spela om pengar: tre spärrar att sätta upp i dag, hur du tar dig igenom ett sug och var du får gratis hjälp av människor.
- [Så får du banken att stoppa spelbetalningar](https://trysilex.com/sv/sparra-speltransaktioner-banken/index.md) (Svenska): Få svenska banker har en spelspärr. Här är Revoluts Spelspärr, kortinställningarna hos Nordea och Handelsbanken, Lånestopp och varför väntetiden är poängen.
- [Stäng av dig från spel: den starkaste spärren som finns](https://trysilex.com/sv/stang-av-dig-fran-spel/index.md) (Svenska): Så fungerar Spelpaus: en gratis avstängning hos alla spelbolag med svensk licens, hur lång tid du kan välja, vad den missar och vad du gör sedan.
- [Support](https://trysilex.com/sv/support/index.md) (Svenska): Hjälp med Silex: prenumeration och uppsägning, återställa ett köp, DNS-skölden, Safari-blockeraren och hur du når en människa.
- [Test för spelberoende: de 9 frågorna i PGSI](https://trysilex.com/sv/test-spelberoende/index.md) (Svenska): Gör PGSI, standardtestet med 9 frågor om risken för spelproblem. Allt sker i din egen webbläsare: inget sparas och inget skickas.
- [Vad händer när du slutar spela om pengar?](https://trysilex.com/sv/vad-hander-nar-du-slutar-spela/index.md) (Svenska): Abstinens, sömn, humör, pengar och riskveckor: så ser de första 90 dagarna utan spel om pengar ofta ut, och under vilka veckor folk får återfall.
- [Användarvillkor](https://trysilex.com/sv/villkor/index.md) (Svenska): Villkoren för appen Silex, webbplatsens kostnadsfria verktyg, webbläsartillägget och loggboken i Notion. Korta, tydliga och ärliga om vad Silex inte är.
- [赌博成瘾测试：PGSI 的 9 道题](https://trysilex.com/zh/du-bo-cheng-yin-ce-shi/index.md) (中文): 做一下 PGSI——评估赌博成瘾风险的标准 9 题问卷。在你的浏览器里运行，不保存也不发送任何内容。
- [赌博损失计算器](https://trysilex.com/zh/du-bo-sun-shi-ji-suan-qi/index.md) (中文): 输入你一周通常输掉多少，看看一年、五年、十年的总额，以及这笔钱本可以变成多少。不保存任何内容。
- [赌瘾发作能持续多久？](https://trysilex.com/zh/du-yin-chi-xu-duo-jiu/index.md) (中文): 想赌的冲动就像一道浪：升起、到顶、退去，通常在 20 到 30 分钟内。头几周会经历什么，以及怎样熬过去。

- [如何戒赌](https://trysilex.com/zh/ru-he-jie-du/index.md) (中文): 一套实用的戒赌方法：今天就该设好的三道屏障、如何熬过想赌的冲动，以及香港、台湾、新加坡的免费求助渠道。
